data.one_liner: A Flutter icon library providing Bold, Linear, and Broken styles from Iconsax.
data.what_it_does: It supplies a collection of vector icons that can be used with the Icon widget. The icons are grouped into three visual styles and can be accessed via static fields.
use_when: You need a wide range of free icons for a Flutter UI
You prefer the Iconsax design language
You want multiple style variants for the same icon
avoid_when: You already use another icon package that covers your needs
You need icons that are not part of the Iconsax set
strengths: Large icon set with three styles
MIT licensed and free for commercial use
Easy to integrate via a single dependency
weaknesses: No support for custom icon fonts
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec.yaml and import package

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a different icon set with similar usage pattern
